record.body:
## Correction

Parent review of the 4963bc9 screenshots asks for four fixes before close:
1. Activity lines name the task and read as a sentence: "dashboard-app assigned to sub-dashboard-app", "dashboard-snapshot reported pass", "dashboard-snapshot tdd check passed". Drop "pass (pass)" and "check check".
2. At 60 columns activity lines are clipped with "…", never wrapped.
3. The footer has no command-palette entry, and every binding label fits at 60 columns.
4. At 120 columns the task title column uses the spare width before it truncates.
